entries.title: Cycles And Symmetric Division Of The Octave In The Works Of John Coltrane
entries.locator: PDF page 7 (zero-based page 6); Countdown and Giant Steps section, opening sentence, before footnote 21
entries.claim_scope: Explicit album release-year assertion, not the preceding 1959 recording-year statement.
entries.review_caution: This weaker source may contain a release/recording error. Preserve its attributed claim; do not conclude the dates are equally credible or settle truth by vote.

entries.title: Blur at the BRITs: 1995 - 2012
entries.locator: Paragraph on the 2012 Outstanding Contribution award; historical Britpop scene description
entries.claim_scope: External classification of Blur within the historical Britpop movement.
entries.review_caution: Britpop must be reviewed as a music scene/movement here, not merely a genre label.
entries.publication_date_basis: Year in the official archive URL/title; exact day unavailable.

entries.title: Blur: ‘We’re not AC/DC. We’ve never been basic. We play too many chords to be basic’
entries.speaker_or_author: Graham Coxon (attribution in paragraph; verify turn boundary)
entries.locator: Interview paragraph about Blair, England and political appropriation; final two sentences of the answer following Coxon adds
entries.claim_scope: Retrospective self-identification concerning historical Britpop, not solely current 2023 membership.
entries.review_caution: May reject a political/national branding rather than deny membership in a broad scene. Human must decide whether this is the same predicate/scope as the external classification.

entries.title: An awfully big adventure
entries.speaker_or_author: Dorian Lynskey (author’s account, not an artist quote)
entries.locator: Historical Cluster paragraph starting Music critics have explained Krautrock; excerpt of the second sentence, whose grammatical subject is Cluster
entries.claim_scope: Stockhausen’s influence on early Cluster experimental music.
entries.review_caution: The short excerpt relies on the preceding subject Cluster. Review full sentence. This is author interpretation, not a direct admission by Roedelius.

entries.publisher: Indie-eye / Federico Fragasso and Michele Baldini
entries.title: Cluster: l’intervista a Dieter Moebius e Hans-Joachim Roedelius, marzo 2010
entries.locator: Moebius answer immediately after question whether Stockhausen influenced them as he did other Krautrock artists
entries.claim_scope: Cluster’s historical musical influence attribution to Stockhausen; interview recorded 2010-03-19.
entries.review_caution: Italian original is retained. Direi di no is qualified denial (I would say no). Do not expand it into an absolute denial by every member or all Krautrock bands.
